title: ValueSnapshot
description: What something was worth over a stretch of time — a score, or a person saying yes or no to a generation. A reading taken, never a running total: two snapshots of the same thing are both true of their own window. Keys are snake_case, not the camelCase the rest of leaf uses: this travels inside a Liquid envelope, whose own fields (event_id, occurred_at, event_type, owner_unit_ref) are snake_case and pinned byte-exact by signed golden vectors. The shape follows the wire.

value.description: The reading, normalised. A thumb up is 1 and a thumb down is 0; what any other number means belongs to whoever took it.

session_id.description: The working session it was taken in.

window_start.description: Start of the stretch the reading covers. Equal to the end for a reading of one moment, such as a thumb.

window_end.description: End of the stretch the reading covers.
